I'm pretty sure that's super against Amazon's seller policies to do that. But I decided to email them and say I left my review and wanted my gift (I didn't leave a review and still haven't). So my question is, WIBTA if I were to report them to Amazon after receiving my free item like that? If so, what should I do instead?
